text:
Aisha: Heads-up 1: weekly KPI snapshot shows registrations down ~35% vs last week, but paid clicks are flat. Something's off with source attribution.
Julian: I was just looking at the same. Webinar page sessions ok, but registration rate fell. Could be a UI change or a tracking bug. :eyes:
Priya: Quick check  I see a bump in `referrer=launch-post` and a parallel rise in `utm_campaign=unknown`. Wonder if our LinkedIn launch post redirect lost UTM.
Elena: We rolled the short-link redirect Tuesday midday for the launch posts. That could have dropped query params if the redirect didn't preserve them.
Priya: Running a join between pageviews and server logs to see original landing URLs. Snippet:```SELECT pv.date, pv.path, COUNT(*) as pv_count, SUM(registration) as regs FROM analytics.pageviews pv LEFT JOIN server.access_logs al ON pv.client_id = al.cid WHERE pv.date >= '2026-04-07' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY regs DESC;```
Priya: Early result: ~900 sessions hit the redirect and show empty utm_campaign between 2026-04-08 and 2026-04-09. That maps to ~150 missing registrations. :frowning:
Aisha: Oof. Stakeholders expect KPI email Monday with week-over-week commentary. Do we hold the email?
Julian: My vote: send the email but mark the affected KPIs as "provisional" with a short note "redirect/UTM loss impacting registration attribution for Apr 8-9". Keeps cadence but signals risk.
Elena: Agree. Also we should flag all benchmarks that use registration volume (benchmarks for webinar conversion, CPL). We'll need to regenerate benchmarks after we correct attribution.
MetricsBot: Automated alert: redirect-preserve-utm rule failed at 2026-04-08T12:03:22Z (incident_id=inc-20260408-utm).
Priya: I opened a small backfill job to re-map sessions using original access_logs path. PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing-analytics/pull/521. Backfill ETA ~4h.
Aisha: Thanks. Can we also add a data_confidence column to the dashboard and set it to low for Apr 8-9? That will make the provisional state obvious to readers.
Julian: I'll add the UI badge and reasoning blurb in the dashboard. ETA 2h.
Elena: Sales ops note: If UTM missing, leads might land in CRM with source unknown. @Elena I'll coordinate with Sales to tag leads from Apr 8-9 as "needs review".
Elena: Filed CRM task: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MKT-312.
Priya: Backfill progress: 12% complete. So far remapping recovers ~72% of the missing campaign tags.
Aisha: Perfect. Once backfill finishes, we should regenerate the dashboard and publish a follow-up email with corrected numbers and a one-paragraph explanation of the fix and its cause (redirect change). Keep language simple for execs.
Julian: Also let's capture this in runbook notes so future redirect work includes preserving UTMs tester. I'll add to marketing runbook.
MetricsBot: Backfill job bf-20260408-01 running  progress 12%  ETA ~3h50m.
Priya: If backfill fails we can still publish the weekly email but include a single-line caveat and link to this thread for details.
Aisha: I'll draft the email with provisional KPIs and the caveat. Will wait for final note from Julian on the dashboard badge before sending.
Julian: Dashboard badge PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing-dash/pull/445 (in review).
Elena: Thanks team  ping me when backfill completes and I'll update Sales ops to avoid follow-ups on noisy leads.
Aisha: Good plan. We'll keep the KPI cadence but mark data confidence low and follow up with corrected numbers if/when backfill finishes. :thumbsup:
